select count(1) from mall_product_stock where product_id = #{productId} and store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_product_stock(product_id, store_id, stock, create_time, update_time) values(#{productId}, #{storeId}, #{stock}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update stock = #{stock}, update_time = now()
mapper.delete: delete from mall_product_stock where product_id = #{productId} and store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: select ps.product_id as productId, ps.store_id as storeId, ps.stock as stock, ps.create_time as createTime, ps.update_time as updateTime, p.name as productName from mall_product_stock ps left join mall_product p on p.product_id = ps.product_id where ps.store_id = #{storeId} order by ps.product_id
